sentences.text: Indrapal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 May, 2025

Author: Siddharth
Bench: Siddharth
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:75143
Court No. - 47
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 30664 of 2024
Applicant :- Indrapal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Byas Kumar Prasad,Rajrshi Gupta,Shaiwal Kumar Gupta

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Indrapal, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 282 of 2024, under Section- 376 AB of I.P.C., and section 5(m)/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Sadar Bazar, District- Shahjahanpur,
There is allegation against the applicant of committing the offence of rape against a minor girl aged about 7 years.
From the medical report of the victim, there are clear signs of commission of alleged offence against her.
This Court after hearing the learned counsels for the parties does not finds any ground for enlarging the applicant on bail at this stage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 The bail application is accordingly, rejected.

The trial court is directed to conclude the trial against the applicant as expeditiously as possible, as per section 309 Cr.P.C. (new section 346 B.N.S.S.) Registrar(Compliance) is directed to communicate this order to the concerned court below within ten days.
